wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/watch_ci.sh: #!/bin/zsh
# Watch the CI workflow on Guikingone/elephc for the current ci/streams-csv-fullci head.
HEAD_PREFIX="${1:-262f2aec22}"
rid=""
prev=""
prevfails=""
tries=0
while [ -z "$rid" ] && [ $tries -lt 20 ]; do
  rid=$(gh run list -R Guikingone/elephc --branch ci/streams-csv-fullci -L 10 --json databaseId,workflowName,headSha --jq ".[] | select(.workflowName == \"CI\") | select(.headSha | startswith(\"$HEAD_PREFIX\")) | .databaseId" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  [ -z "$rid" ] && { tries=$((tries+1)); sleep 30; }
done
if [ -z "$rid" ]; then
  echo "NO CI RUN FOUND for head $HEAD_PREFIX"
  exit 0
fi
